records.text: A CIA-contractor's spouse warned Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson on September 10 to lay low because a list was circulating
records.speaker: CIA-contractor spouse warning source (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Another person was a very well-known woman who happens to be married to a CIA contractor. ... Same exact message. "You and Tucker (Tucker Carlson)." But, of course, we cannot tell you who we are getting this information from.

verification.notes: Reviewed the source-specific transcript context and performed live searches for the alleged September 10 warning, the supposed list, and the unidentified CIA contractor's spouse. The public record only reproduces Candace Owens's account; no recording, message, named source, or independent first-hand confirmation was found. Because the claim rests on an unidentified private communication, it cannot be resolved beyond documenting that Owens reported it.

sources.title: Another French Front: Did Charlie Kirk Save My Life? | Candace Ep 269
